scope: Every GLB in content/worldgen, including editable masters and imported runtime assets. Masters/runtime pairs are counted separately.
method: Read glTF2 JSON chunks; inventory images, texture records, vertex colors and shared-surface bindings. Embedded image bytes are hash-compared; no images or unique artwork are modified.
conclusion: No embedded bitmap textures exist to extract. Reusable architectural texture sources are the canonical material graphs; original vertex-color PBR remains the portable model fallback.
